native_resource_heap_allocator.fast_path: same material generation and sufficient remaining capacity; append only
native_resource_heap_allocator.generation_change: select a newly allocated or fence-completed pool record
native_resource_heap_allocator.reuse_gate: native device fence GetCompletedValue >= saved record+0x20
native_resource_heap_allocator.material_prefix_refresh: after new allocation or successful reuse gate
native_resource_heap_allocator.allocation_stamps: current native device epoch at record+0x20
native_resource_heap_allocator.implication: A later current provider or material generation is not the saved recording heap. Carry and validate its exact record.
native_resource_heap_allocator.limits: Covers this native allocator. Does not retain referenced resources, exclude AS/geometry writes, or authorize deferred rays by itself.

present_order: signal native fence at value N
stamp deferred-release batch with N+1 and fence

native_sbt_timeline.slot_selection: increment +a8 fence value, select parity, stride 0x50
native_sbt_timeline.replay_requirement: Preserve native SBT bytes before these native lifetime cuts; retaining a resource pointer or Present timeline alone is insufficient

remaining: Geometry/BLAS suballocation recycling and mutable contents
Transitive and concurrent writes between GI ray and shade
Actual consumer submitted before native retirement boundary
